description:
Migrate the matvec SIMD threshold (baked) and the two transpose selectors (runtime resolved reads) to the tuning profile.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §2 fixes the two field kinds and the mechanism rule with four structural read-pattern obligations, §3 gives every field its name, range, default-naming constant, read site and mechanism, §4 names the route reporter and test obligation per family, and §5.3 states the ratified amortisation screening rule and the behaviour-preservation argument (defaults name the in-source constants; observable behaviour unchanged when no profile is installed). Design §3.1 and the bit_matrix row of §4.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: matvec_simd_min_words is baked behind the gf2_tuning_baked cfg and transpose_simple_max_blocks / transpose_macro_tile_blocks are runtime resolved reads satisfying design §2.3's four obligations, operators and arithmetic byte-for-byte unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: matvec_route and transpose_route reporters exist, the dispatchers themselves call them, boundary route-observation tests and the baked matvec witness (wired into the CI baked step) pass.
- [hard] REQ-03: Migrated constants' rustdoc states the default-definition role and names the profile field; existing behaviour tests pass unchanged with no profile installed.
title: Cut the bit-matrix selectors over to the tuning profile
